numerator: Items waiting in the referral queue and the feed queue: how many, the median and the oldest age, and how many are past the local limit
denominator: All items that entered a queue in the period
limits: A short queue can mean items were matched wrongly; read with M-02 and M-03

numerator: Merges; unmerges; records later found to be two people
denominator: Patient records, and for unmerges the merges
owner: CSO for each unmerge; maintainer for the trend
limits: Small numbers swing; an unmerge shows a caught error and not all errors

numerator: Pairs that the matcher gives to a person, found after both records existed
limits: Blind to duplicates that the matcher does not see

numerator: Links and refusals whose stored explanation names every compared field, with a reason where evidence is absent
limits: Tests a property and not accuracy

numerator: Referrals with a matched outcome or decline; time to it; open past the timeout
limits: Closed is not clinically done; needs a timeout for each urgency

numerator: Outcomes and declines that match no referral, and their age
limits: A zero can mean the key is too loose: sample by hand

measure: Refused HL7 messages nobody looked at
numerator: Refused messages not resolved within the local limit
limits: Resolved is not the same as understood

numerator: Patients shown not recorded; retractions; time to a second look at a retraction
limits: Cannot show that an allergy is true; a retraction may be right

numerator: Alerts overridden, and with no reason
denominator: Alerts shown, for each clinician-day and kind
limits: Never a target on its own; for when there are alerts; nothing is kept today

numerator: Views of a list that hit a limit, and those that did not say so
limits: Counts the notice and not whether it was seen; no view event is kept today

numerator: Failures of the banner, unit and small-screen tests
limits: Structure only; from the tests in CI

numerator: Age of the snapshot at each check; exercises failed; clinical requests refused by a limit
owner: Site lead; CSO on any failure
limits: An exercise is not an outage; exercises are kept outside the service

numerator: Invalid identifiers refused; edit conflicts caught; retried writes kept once
limits: Refusals fall when input improves and also when checks are bypassed; from the answers 409 and 422, which nothing counts today

numerator: Decided; accepted; denied; denied with no reason; time to a decision
owner: Privacy officer; CSO for a pattern
limits: Says nothing of whether a decision was right

numerator: Grants opened; reviews overdue; grants judged inappropriate
limits: About named staff: see the risks of measuring

measure: Accesses with no audit row, and the chain
numerator: Requests answered with no audit row; refusals that could not be audited; chain checks that failed
limits: A clean chain shows integrity and not that the right things were logged

numerator: Labels added; lifted; lifted within a day; lists read with something withheld; reads that break-glass showed
denominator: Entries; reads of the three lists
owner: Privacy officer; CSO for a pattern
limits: Cannot count a label that should be there and is not
